verdicts.reason: A: the quote is set very small and jammed against an attribution of nearly the same weight. The logo in the top right is oversized and competes with the quote. The can floats on its own, half off the circle, with an unreadable label. Still, the product survives. B: the quote is more readable, but the attribution is bigger and bolder than the quote, which inverts the hierarchy. The can is shrunk to a tiny unrecognisable sliver beside a tiny logo, jammed together at the bottom, so the key product image is effectively lost.
